parts.text: 刷新后 8101 已返回候选构建的分支哈希，实际站点切换成功。按任务计划先扫描候选产物，确认测试专用标记和 mock token 未进入构建，再运行现有的定制 Playwright E2E（它是 Node 脚本，不使用 `playwright test` CLI）。

tool_input.description: Scan candidate dist for E2E-only markers
tool_input.command:
$patterns = @('E2E_NAV_FIXTURE_ONLY_MARKER', 'e2e-mock-token')
$matches = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'D:\repository\苏住房G\worktrees\task2468-navbar-visual\dist' -File -Recurse | Select-String -SimpleMatch -Pattern $patterns -List
if ($matches) {
  $matches | Select-Object Path, LineNumber
  throw 'Test-only marker found in candidate dist'
}
Write-Output 'No E2E-only markers in candidate dist.'
